column1: # Boot Bitch test manifest and budget contract.
#   check [--quick]           validate format, registration and budgets (CI runs it)
#   update                    regenerate rows from CMakeLists.txt (new rows get cost_s 0)
#   approve <test> '<note>'   approve a budget overage (appends to test-budget-exceptions.tsv)
#   quick-exclude             print the -E regex (fast quick=n rows) for the dev-check quick tier
#   quick-excluded            print those rows' short names joined with '/' (skipped-list text)
# Budget directives (seconds per tier; the declared cost_s sums must stay under):
#   test     full ctest test name (add_test NAME in CMakeLists.txt)
#   cost_s   declared wall-clock cost in seconds (measured upper bound, integer)
#   class    cost class matching cost_s: S <= 5 s, M <= 60 s, L > 60 s
#   owner    free-form owner tag for humans (unused by the gate)
#   quick    y = runs in the --quick gate (fast tier only), n = never in --quick;
#            the n rows of tier fast are the dev-check quick-tier exclusions
